text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Thursday that $730 million of automobile receivables-backed securities were priced through Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp as lead manager.
Bear, Stearns & Co Inc and J.P. Morgan & Co were co-managers.

This transaction, when added to the remaining 1996-C prefund which was completed this quarter, gives Olympic the possibility of selling up to $758 million of automobile loans in the fourth quarter of 1996.

"The reception of this transaction by investors was excellent," Warren Kantor, chairman, said in a statement. "With the record interest spreads the company achieved on this securitization, this marks the largest and most profitable securitization in the company's history."
